english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for shaking off a person, problem, or unwanted thing.

examples.english: I finally rid myself of that annoying salesperson.
examples.traditional: 我終於甩咗個煩人嘅推銷員。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 lat1 zo2 go3 faan4 jan4 ge3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4

english.note: Use this when an attached thing has come loose or come off, especially in casual speech.
Use 甩 for something coming out of position, or for someone escaping your grasp; it does not mean every kind of quiet movement.

examples.english: The button did detach from my shirt.
The fish slip out of my hand and swim away.
examples.traditional: 條魚喺我手上甩咗，游走咗。
examples.jyutping: tiu4 jyu4 hai2 ngo5 sau2 soeng6 lat1 zo2 jau4 zau2 zo2
